subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Foment
solution:
The correct answer is: **Regulate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"foment"** means to instigate or stir up an undesirable or violent sentiment or course of action. (उकसाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of fomenting violence during the protests.
 
 
 
• **"Regulate"** means to control or maintain the rate or speed of a machine or process so that it operates properly. (नियंत्रित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The government plans to regulate the financial market to prevent fraud.
